notes.title: 0.10 + Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]Switch from Demo to Playtest[/h1]
After seeing what the other indie FPS developers were doing I decided to switch the marketing model of BulletSpeed.
I will switch to a basic version model of the free game, and the solo content will be sold as DLC.
This will allow the free and paid version to play together on the same servers.
The price of DLC is not yet estimated and will be estimated at the height of the game time that can offer the single player content.
[b]Until the multiplayer content is looped the game will probably remain in playtest open. [/b]


[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
[h2]Weapon System Rework[/h2]
[h3]Ammo[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ammunition is now grouped by category and not by weapon.
[*] Ammo packs reload at 30% of maximum capacity.
[*] Weapons drop take 15% of the corresponding ammo from the player who drops it.
[*] Weapons created by the map have 50% of maximum ammunition.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/3e945716a8454a959538c732bbabf9a628d29740.png[/img]
[h3]Melee[/h3]
[list]
[*] Left Click (default) puts a cost to 75 damage and causes recoil to the player touch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/6ee5be9bc0ec64786e54157183b985ac04332e15.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/e888ae03a47ee8069a11982e30282de7ac581174.gif[/img]
[*] Right click press (default) will charge a powerful hit that will send once the key release and cause a more powerful recoil to the player touch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/bc4fcbf2aa158896d90f890a0438f04d3a72c7bb.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/3941ad8de662b84ea162a01d9a9c39634e1e8883.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]New pickable ![/h2]
[h3]Scaped Metals[/h3]
Upon their death, players drop "scrapped metals" to their death allowing to heal themselves in life/armor up to +50.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/91b9bc02a1bfdb102be14ea551b9231e6b9a1f90.png[/img]
[h2]Better hit ![/h2]
[h3]Hitbox[/h3]
Creation of hitbox linked to the body parts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/941413a840c4b0d0c487d34a0b6e3b4bc9fa9af4.png[/img]


[h1]VISUALS[/h1]
[h2]Model Rework[/h2]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
Complete redesign of third-person animations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/7df90b10e4271277aeef6f2b85433d4beb7fae1e.gif[/img]
[h2]VFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] New trails more optimized for bullets.
[*] Trail behind the player when they dash or wall-jump.
[*] New effects for Deathzone, MapLimit and all triggers.
[/list]
[h3]Models[/h3]
New model for ammunition boxes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/ab998d418df195069380a9a13e675aefc174d655.png[/img]


[h1]CUSTOM CONTENT[/h1]
[h2]Map creation[/h2]
You can now create maps with the guide available here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3358286673&preview=true
[b]Workshop will come later for now you can use the discussions to share maps.[/b]


[h1]FIXS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed player spawn.
[*] Fixed weapon start.
[*] Many other little fixs.
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer / Visual
notes.content:
[h1]Steam P2P[/h1]

[h2]Steam P2P is on Bullet Speed ![/h2]

In other words, it is now much easier to play multiplayer thanks to the Steam lobby system which now replaces the old system.
It is still possible to play with UPNP to open ports but the servers will not appear in the server list and will have to be connected to via IP.



[h2]VFX[/h2]

[h2]Rework and addition of visual effects ![/h2]
I'll let you discover in game :)


[i]Note: Work on single player content is still in progress, the first thing available will probably be an arena mode with infinite wave of enemies and a leaderboard.
JMP leaderboards will be available with the next JMP maps.[/i]

notes.title: 0.9.0 IS OUT !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/e5a2870a43d4ed8dda0e31d588636aef4e4cdc0d.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	New maps: Temple (DM 2-4 players).
[*] 	Weapon knockback property: Push the player in the opposite direction he shot.
[*] 		Electrifier: 0 -> 0.3
[*] 	Weapon damage:
[*] 		Headshot: 2x  -> 2.5x
[*] 		Revolver: 100 -> 80
[*] 	Weapon make decal property.
[*] 	Bullets ignore collision against objects (Pickables).
[*] 	If you had a starter weapon in hand when you were killed, you drop ammo instead of the weapon.	
[*] 	Disabled move when the menu is open.
[*] 	Open the menu if the game is not focused while in game.
[/list]

[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Scaled down the floor texture on all maps.
[*] 	Slight fog on JMP maps.
[*] 	Hitmarker animation.
[*] 	New HUD elements: Altimeter, Distance measurement, Info box
[*] 	Glitch effect on hurt and death.
[*] 	New graphics options: SDFGI, SSIL, Vsync, Weapon FOV
[/list]

[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Hurt sound is more "machine like".
[*] 	Change all music format to OGG so it loops correctly now.
[/list]

[b]Network:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Big network optimization.
[*] 		Less bandwith usage.
[*] 		More reliable data sending and receiving.
[*] 		Better spray compression.
[*] 		Refactored the way physic bullets worked.
[*] 	Display the server IP in the netinfo box (bottom right in game), enabled by default (setting is in option/game).
[*] 	ONLINE setting for the server creation is enabled by default. 
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Loading screen that compile shader and preload objects.
[*] 	Game build size optimization (From 841Mo to 337Mo).
[*] 	Game localization: English, French, Russian (more comming soon)
[/list]

[b]Fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Fixed a bug where some clients couldn't zoom with the sniper.
[*] 	Fixed a self shooting issue with collisions.
[*] 	Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
